points: New offences: making or spreading sexualised deepfakes, spreading other reputation-damaging deepfakes, identity misuse
Also covers digital voyeurism and covert GPS-tracker surveillance; draft first published in April
Bill now goes to parliament; the press release gives no penalties or timetable
read: BMJV press release on the Gesetz gegen digitale Gewalt, 7 Oct 2026 (German)

src.name: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz

take: Germany moves to criminalise damaging deepfakes and identity misuse, not just sexual ones. Relevant for executive-impersonation fraud and for platforms hosting synthetic media.
title: German cabinet: harmful deepfakes and identity misuse to become crimes
